hints.title: Strip Spaces and Dashes
hints.text: Filter out all spaces and hyphens from the input string to retain only digit characters.

hints.title: Group Triples While Greater Than 4
hints.text: Group digits into blocks of 3 while more than 4 digits remain.

hints.title: Handle Remainder
hints.text: If 4 digits remain, split into two blocks of 2; otherwise leave remaining 2 or 3 digits as a single final block.
